标签: #AI编程 #智能体 #代码工具

摘要: 本期AI动态聚焦：Claude新增交互式图表生成功能，马斯克从Cursor挖角核心人才加入xAI，同时Cursor正以500亿美元估值融资。此外，形式验证代码、代理商务及机构级AI应用成为行业关注的新趋势。

原标题: Claude Visuals 💻, xAI poaches Cursor leads 💼, CursorBench 🧑‍💻

TLDR AI 2026-03-13

## Claude Visuals 💻, xAI poaches Cursor leads 💼, CursorBench 🧑‍💻

## Claude 可视化功能 💻、xAI 挖角 Cursor 负责人 💼、CursorBench 基准测试 🧑‍💻

Cursor is raising at a $50 billion valuation (3 minute read)

Elon Musk just pulled two of Cursor's product leaders into a $1.25 trillion company and told them to build xAI's coding product. AI coding is now a $5 billion+ market. xAI is the only frontier lab without a coding product printing money. AI labs have figured out that developers are the highest-willingness-to-pay users on the planet.

埃隆·马斯克刚刚将 Cursor 的两位产品负责人挖走，加入这家市值 1.25 万亿美元的公司，并要求他们打造 xAI 的编程产品。AI 编程现已形成一个超过 50 亿美元的市场。xAI 是目前唯一一家没有推出赚钱编程产品的前沿实验室。各大 AI 实验室已经意识到，开发者是全球付费意愿最高的用户群体。

Claude now creates interactive charts, diagrams, and visualizations (5 minute read)

A beta version of Imagine with Claude is coming to Claude Chat. The feature can create custom charts, diagrams, and other visualizations, and then tweak and modify its creations as the conversation develops. The feature will be on by default, with Claude deciding when to build a visual for something. Users can directly request a visual. Videos showing example visualizations are available in the article.

Imagine with Claude 的测试版本即将登陆 Claude Chat。该功能可以创建自定义图表、示意图及其他可视化内容，并能在对话过程中不断调整和修改生成的作品。此功能默认开启，由 Claude 自主判断何时为某个主题生成可视化内容。用户也可以直接请求生成可视化。文中提供了展示示例可视化效果的视频。

Meta Delays Rollout of New AI Model After Performance Concerns (6 minute read)

Meta's Avocado model outperforms the company's previous model and the Google Gemini 2.5 model from March, but it doesn't perform as strongly against leading models from Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic. The company has decided to delay the model's release to at least May. Experts believe Meta still has time to catch up to rivals. The company's Llama 4 release fell short of expectations last year.

Meta 的 Avocado 模型虽优于该公司此前的模型以及 谷歌（Google）三月份发布的 Gemini 2.5 模型，但在与谷歌、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的领先模型对比时表现不佳。该公司已决定将模型发布推迟至至少五月。专家认为 Meta 仍有时间追赶竞争对手。该公司去年发布的 Llama 4 并未达到预期。

AI Writes Buggy Code. A Silicon Valley Start-Up Wants to Fix It (4 minute read)

Axiom raised a $200M Series A at a $1.6B valuation led by Menlo Ventures, one year after founding and with roughly 20 employees, to build what it calls Verified AI: systems that produce formally verified outputs in the programming language Lean, where every reasoning step is machine-checkable, and errors are caught deterministically rather than statistically. The company originally trained on math proofs and then transferred that skill to code verification, a technique that lets it prove not only that code produces correct outputs but also that it won't create unexpected attack surfaces.

Axiom 在成立一年后、仅有约 20 名员工的情况下，由 Menlo Ventures 领投，完成了 2 亿美元的 A 轮融资，估值达 16 亿美元。该公司致力于构建所谓的 Verified AI（经验证的人工智能）：在 Lean 编程语言中生成经过形式化验证的输出，其中每个推理步骤均可被机器检验，错误能够被确定性（而非统计性）地捕获。该公司最初在数学证明上进行训练，随后将这项技能迁移至代码验证，这种技术不仅能证明代码产生正确的输出，还能证明它不会产生意外的攻击面。

Reverse-engineering Claude's generative UI - then building it for the terminal (27 minute read)

Claude's generative UI is a tool call that returns HTML injected into the DOM with incremental parsing as tokens stream. It enables interactive widgets to be rendered inline in Claude conversations. It uses lazy-loading documentation to insert context on demand. The terminal spawns Glimpse windows with bidirectional JSON communication, allowing the terminal to stay as a terminal while the visual content gets a real browser engine.

Claude 的 生成式 UI（generative UI）是一种工具调用，它返回 HTML 并在令牌流式传输时通过增量解析注入到 DOM 中。这使得交互式小部件能够在 Claude 对话中内联渲染。它使用懒加载文档按需插入上下文。终端生成 Glimpse 窗口，通过双向 JSON 通信，让终端保持终端的本质，同时让视觉内容获得真正的浏览器引擎支持。

Agentic Commerce (11 minute read)

Commerce has historically been closer to a seller's market. Consumers are largely shown what platforms choose to surface. AI agents will gradually shift the power toward the buyer. Instead of navigating the layer of market and platform incentives, AI will enable consumers to access the best product for their needs directly. This dynamic may be most powerful in B2B commerce, which has historically been opaque, fragmented, and relationship-driven.

商业历史上更接近卖方市场。消费者很大程度上只能看到平台选择展示的内容。AI 代理（AI agents）将逐渐把权力转向买方。AI 将使消费者能够直接获取最适合其需求的产品，而无需在市场和平台激励的层层结构中 navigating。这种动态在 B2B 商业领域可能最为强大，因为该领域历来不透明、碎片化且以关系为导向。

Institutional AI vs Individual AI (16 minute read)

Institutional AI could unlock far more value than individual AI by redesigning organizations alongside technology. Unlike individual AI, which boosts productivity with little firm value impact, institutional AI focuses on coordination, finding signals in data, countering bias, and scaling revenue. Successful organizations will be those that integrate AI as a foundational component, similar to the industrial shift to electric assembly lines.

机构 AI（Institutional AI）可能通过与技术同步重构组织，释放比 个人 AI（Individual AI）更大的价值。与个人 AI 仅提升生产力却对企业价值影响有限不同，机构 AI 专注于协调（coordination）、从数据中发现信号、消除偏见以及扩大收入规模。成功的组织将是那些将 AI 整合为基础组件的组织，类似于工业界向电力装配线的转变。

How we compare model quality in Cursor (7 minute read)

Cursor uses a hybrid online-offline eval process to keep its understanding of model quality aligned with what developers actually do. The offline part uses CursorBench, an internal eval suite based on real Cursor sessions from Cursor's engineering team. It measures multiple dimensions of agent performance, including collusion correctness, code quality, efficiency, and interaction behavior. The online part involves a controlled analysis on live traffic, which catches regressions that offline suites miss. Together, this loop keeps Cursor's notion of model quality grounded in production as workflows change.

Cursor 采用混合的线上线下评估（online-offline eval）流程，以确保其对模型质量的理解与开发者的实际行为保持一致。离线部分使用 CursorBench，这是一个基于 Cursor 工程团队真实会话的内部评估套件。它衡量代理性能的多个维度，包括协同正确性、代码质量、效率和交互行为。在线部分涉及对实时流量的受控分析，能够捕捉离线套件遗漏的回归问题。两者结合，这个闭环确保 Cursor 的模型质量概念能够随着工作流程的变化而扎根于实际生产环境。

We built RLM for coding. And it F*cking rocks. Swarm native agents are here to stay (13 minute read)

Slate is a frontier agent that uses a code environment for swarm orchestration. It can programmatically orchestrate and solve tasks by running a massive number of subagents. Slate supports a range of models and automatically selects the right model for the job. It uses novel context engineering and maximizes caching to lower costs.

Slate 是一个前沿代理，它使用代码环境进行群体编排（swarm orchestration）。它可以通过运行大量子代理（subagents）以编程方式编排和解决任务。Slate 支持多种模型，并能自动为特定任务选择最合适的模型。它采用新颖的上下文工程技术，并最大化缓存利用率以降低成本。

OpenClaw Reinforcement Learning Framework (GitHub Repo)

OpenClaw-RL is an asynchronous reinforcement learning framework for training personalized AI agents from everyday conversations. It supports large-scale environment parallelization for developing more general agents.

OpenClaw-RL 是一个异步强化学习（reinforcement learning）框架，用于从日常对话中训练个性化的 AI 代理。它支持大规模环境并行化，以开发更通用的代理。

I was backend lead at Manus. After building agents for 2 years, I stopped using function calling entirely. Here's what I use instead (14 minute read)

A single run(command="...") tool with Unix-style commands outperforms a catalog of typed function calling. Unix made the design decision 50 years ago to make everything a text stream. Large language models made an almost identical decision by making everything tokens. The text-based system that Unix uses is a natural fit for large language models. They can act as terminal operators faster than any human. Developers just need to take what Unix has proven over the last half-century and hand it directly to AI.

一个带有 Unix 风格命令的单一 run(command="...") 工具，优于一整个类型化的函数调用（function calling）目录。Unix 在 50 年前做出了将所有内容都作为文本流的设计决策。大语言模型也做出了几乎相同的决策，即将所有内容都转化为令牌（tokens）。Unix 使用的基于文本的系统与大语言模型天然契合。它们可以作为终端操作员比任何人类都更快地行动。开发者只需要将 Unix 在过去半个世纪证明有效的东西直接交给 AI 即可。

The Shape of the Thing (10 minute read)

AI transitioned from co-intelligence to an era of AI management, with systems like Claude Code completing complex tasks autonomously. Exponential improvements in AI capabilities have sparked radical work methods, such as StrongDM's AI-driven Software Factory, and prompted significant market and employment shifts.

AI 正从协同智能（co-intelligence）过渡到AI 管理（AI management）时代，Claude Code 等系统能够自主完成复杂任务。AI 能力的指数级改进催生了激进的工作方法，例如 StrongDM 的 AI 驱动软件工厂（Software Factory），并引发了重大的市场和就业转变。

China's ByteDance Gets Access to Top Nvidia AI Chips (5 minute read)

ByteDance is assembling computing power with high-end Nvidia chips outside China. It is working with a Southeast Asian company called Aolani Cloud on plans to use around 500 Nvidia Blackwell computing systems in Malaysia. The hardware involved is valued at more than $2.5 billion. ByteDance plans to use the computing power for AI research and development outside of China.

字节跳动（ByteDance）正在中国境外利用高端 英伟达（Nvidia）芯片组建算力。该公司正与东南亚公司 Aolani Cloud 合作，计划在马来西亚部署约 500 台英伟达 Blackwell 计算系统。所涉及的硬件价值超过 25 亿美元。字节跳动计划将这些算力用于中国境外的 AI 研发。

item.title: [翻译] Latent Space: 后RAG时代的检索：混合搜索、智能体与数据库设计
item.description:
标签: #RAG #混合搜索 #向量数据库 #AI

摘要: Turbopuffer创始人Simon Eskildsen介绍了这款面向非结构化数据的搜索引擎如何通过完全基于对象存储和NVMe SSD的无共识层架构，将客户搜索成本降低95%。他认为在AI Agent时代，混合检索（语义+文本+正则）和高并发查询将取代传统单次检索模式，成为连接大模型与世界知识的关键基础设施。

原标题: Retrieval After RAG: Hybrid Search, Agents, and Database Design — Simon Hørup Eskildsen of Turbopuffer

Turbopuffer 的起源与愿景

Turbopuffer came out of a reading app.

Turbopuffer 诞生于一款阅读应用。

In 2022, Simon was helping his friends at Readwise scale their infra for a highly requested feature: article recommendations and semantic search. Readwise was paying ~$5k/month for their relational database and vector search would cost ~$20k/month making the feature too expensive to ship. In 2023 after mulling over the problem from Readwise, Simon decided he wanted to "build a search engine" which became Turbopuffer.

2022年，Simon 正在帮助他在 Readwise 的朋友们扩展基础设施，以支持一个呼声很高的功能：文章推荐和 语义搜索（semantic search）。Readwise 当时每月为其关系型数据库支付约5000美元，而 向量搜索（vector search） 的成本将高达每月约2万美元，这使得该功能因过于昂贵而无法上线。2023年，在反复思考 Readwise 面临的问题后，Simon 决定他要"构建一个搜索引擎"，这就是 Turbopuffer 的诞生。

We discuss:
  • Simon’s path: Denmark → Shopify infra for nearly a decade → "angel engineering" across startups like Readwise, Replicate, and Causal → Turbopuffer almost accidentally becoming a company
  • The Readwise origin story: building an early recommendation engine right after the ChatGPT moment, seeing it work, then realizing it would cost ~$30k/month for a company spending ~$5k/month total on infra and getting obsessed with fixing that cost structure
  • Why Turbopuffer is "a search engine for unstructured data": Simon’s belief that models can learn to reason, but can’t compress the world’s knowledge into a few terabytes of weights, so they need to connect to systems that hold truth in full fidelity
  • The three ingredients for building a great database company: a new workload, a new storage architecture, and the ability to eventually support every query plan customers will want on their data
  • The architecture bet behind Turbopuffer: going all in on object storage and NVMe, avoiding a traditional consensus layer, and building around the cloud primitives that only became possible in the last few years
  • Why Simon hated operating Elasticsearch at Shopify: years of painful on-call experience shaped his obsession with simplicity, performance, and eliminating state spread across multiple systems
  • The Cursor story: launching Turbopuffer as a scrappy side project, getting an email from Cursor the next day, flying out after a 4am call, and helping cut Cursor’s costs by 95% while fixing their per-user economics
  • The Notion story: buying dark fiber, tuning TCP windows, and eating cross-cloud costs because Simon refused to compromise on architecture just to close a deal faster
  • Why AI changes the build-vs-buy equation: it’s less about whether a company can build search infra internally, and more about whether they have time especially if an external team can feel like an extension of their own
  • Why RAG isn’t dead: coding companies still rely heavily on search, and Simon sees hybrid retrieval semantic, text, regex, SQL-style patterns becoming more important, not less
  • How agentic workloads are changing search: the old pattern was one retrieval call up front; the new pattern is one agent firing many parallel queries at once, turning search into a highly concurrent tool call
  • Why Turbopuffer is reducing query pricing: agentic systems are dramatically increasing query volume, and Simon expects retrieval infra to adapt to huge bursts of concurrent search rather than a small number of carefully chosen calls
  • The philosophy of "playing with open cards": Simon’s habit of being radically honest with investors, including telling Lachy Groom he’d return the money if Turbopuffer didn’t hit PMF by year-end
  • The "P99 engineer": Simon’s framework for building a talent-dense company, rejecting by default unless someone on the team feels strongly enough to fight for the candidate

本期讨论内容包括：

  • Simon 的职业路径：丹麦 → Shopify 基础设施团队近十年 → 在 Readwise、Replicate 和 Causal 等初创公司做"天使工程师" → Turbopuffer 几乎偶然地成为一家公司
  • Readwise 的起源故事：在 ChatGPT 时刻之后立即构建早期推荐引擎，看到它奏效，然后意识到对于一家基础设施总支出约5000美元/月的公司来说，该功能将花费约3万美元/月，于是痴迷于解决这一成本结构
  • 为什么 Turbopuffer 是"非结构化数据的搜索引擎"：Simon 相信模型可以学习推理，但无法将世界知识压缩到几 TB 的权重中，因此它们需要连接到以完整保真度保存真相的系统
  • 构建伟大数据库公司的三个要素：新的工作负载、新的存储架构，以及最终支持客户对其数据所需的每一种查询计划的能力
  • Turbopuffer 背后的架构赌注：全力投入 对象存储（object storage） 和 NVMe，避免传统的共识层，围绕仅在过去几年才成为可能的云原语构建
  • 为什么 Simon 讨厌在 Shopify 运维 Elasticsearch：多年痛苦的值班经历塑造了他对简洁性、性能的痴迷，以及消除跨多个系统分散的状态
  • Cursor 的故事：将 Turbopuffer 作为一个简陋的副业项目推出，第二天就收到 Cursor 的邮件，在凌晨4点通话后飞过去，帮助 Cursor 削减了95%的成本，同时修复了他们的单用户经济学
  • Notion 的故事：购买暗光纤（dark fiber）、调整 TCP 窗口、承担跨云成本，因为 Simon 拒绝为了更快成交而在架构上妥协
  • 为什么 AI 改变了自建与外采的权衡：问题不在于公司是否能在内部构建搜索基础设施，而在于他们是否有时间，特别是如果外部团队感觉像自己团队的延伸
  • 为什么 RAG（检索增强生成） 没有死：编程公司仍然严重依赖搜索，Simon 认为 混合检索（hybrid retrieval）（语义、文本、正则表达式、SQL 风格模式）正变得更重要，而非更不重要
  • 智能体工作负载（agentic workloads） 如何改变搜索：旧模式是前期一次检索调用；新模式是一个智能体同时触发多个并行查询，将搜索转变为高并发工具调用
  • 为什么 Turbopuffer 正在降低查询定价：智能体系统正在急剧增加查询量，Simon 预计检索基础设施将适应巨大的并发搜索突发，而非少量精心选择的调用
  • "明牌游戏（playing with open cards）"的哲学：Simon 对投资者极度诚实的习惯，包括告诉 Lachy Groom，如果 Turbopuffer 年底前没有达到 PMF（产品市场契合度），他会退还资金
  • "P99 工程师"：Simon 构建人才密集型公司的框架，默认拒绝，除非团队中的某人足够强烈地为候选人争取

item.title: [翻译] Latent Space: 提升对LLM期望的高回报实践
item.description:
标签: #LLM #智能体 #MCP #编程助手

摘要: 本文强调提高对大型语言模型的期望是"高回报活动"，那些敢于突破当前能力边界的"适度疯狂"者往往获得最大收益；同时综述了AI领域在智能体基础设施（MCP协议、工具链）、编码评估方法、多模态检索及模型效率等方面的最新进展。

原标题: [AINews] The high-return activity of raising your aspirations for LLMs

[AINews] 提高对 LLM 期望的高回报活动

We thoroughly enjoyed the charismatic Simon Eskildsen of Turbopuffer on today’s pod, and highly encourage listening in even if you’re not a database nerd:

我们在今天的播客中非常欣赏来自 Turbopuffer 的魅力十足的 Simon Eskildsen，即使你不是一个数据库极客，我们也强烈建议你收听：

As for today’s op-ed, it’s a quiet day. This comment from Aidan is currently living rent-free in my head:

至于今天的专栏文章，今天是个平静的日子。Aidan 的这个评论目前在我脑海中挥之不去：

Tyler Cowen has noted The high-return activity of raising others’ aspirations 8 years ago, and it is commonly the biggest regret we see in others and the biggest regret I have had in my last 3 years covering and tinkering in AI. The people just on the right side of insane have pushed LLMs (Large Language Models, 大语言模型) to their limits and benefited, whereas the pragmatic people who judge and manage LLMs as they were at their time, mostly didn’t go anywhere.

Tyler Cowen 在 8 年前就指出了"提高他人期望"是一项高回报的活动，这也是我们在他人身上常见到的最大遗憾，也是我在过去三年报道和钻研 AI 过程中最大的遗憾。那些处于"理智边缘"（但恰到好处）的人将 LLM（大语言模型）推向了极限并从中受益，而那些务实的、以当时现状来评判和管理 LLM 的人，大多没有取得什么进展。

So a fun question to ask an LLM, which we walk through in our upcoming Claude Cowork pod, is: how can I be more ambitious than what I’m currently doing?

因此，一个向 LLM 提出的有趣问题（我们将在即将推出的 Claude Cowork 播客中探讨）是：我如何才能比目前正在做的事情更有雄心？

AI News for 3/11/2026-3/12/2026. We checked 12 subreddits, 544 Twitters and no further Discords. AINews’ website lets you search all past issues. As a reminder, AINews is now a section of Latent Space. You can opt in/out of email frequencies!

AI 新闻 2026年3月11日-12日。我们检查了 12 个子版块、544 个 Twitter 账号，没有进一步检查 Discord。AINews 的网站允许你搜索所有往期内容。提醒一下，AINews 现在是 Latent Space 的一个栏目。你可以选择接收邮件的频率！

AI Twitter Recap

Agent Infrastructure, Harnesses, and the MCP Debate

  • Harnesses are becoming the real product surface: Multiple posts converged on the view that model quality alone is no longer the bottleneck; the surrounding harness, tools, memory, and runtime matter more. @mattturck’s interview with Harrison Chase frames this explicitly around harnesses, sandboxes, filesystem access, skills, memory, and observability, while @hwchase17 emphasized that agent UI/UX is still hard and underbuilt. That same stack perspective shows up in LangChain JS’s new cross-framework useStream hook, Redis’s context-engineering lab, and Artificial Analysis’s Stirrup Slack integration, which adds Slack-native agents with documents, subagents, MCP (Model Context Protocol, 模型上下文协议), browser use, and code execution.

Harness（框架/ harness）正在成为真正的产品界面：多篇帖子都认同这样一个观点，即模型质量本身已不再是瓶颈； surrounding harness（ surrounding harness/ surrounding harness）、工具、内存和运行时才更重要。@mattturck 对 Harrison Chase 的采访明确围绕 harnesses、沙盒、文件系统访问、技能、内存和可观测性展开，而 @hwchase17 则强调 agent UI/UX（智能体用户界面/用户体验）仍然困难且建设不足。同样的技术栈视角也体现在 LangChain JS 的跨框架 useStream hook、Redis 的上下文工程实验室，以及 Artificial Analysis 的 Stirrup Slack 集成中，后者添加了支持文档、子智能体、MCP（模型上下文协议）、浏览器使用和代码执行的 Slack 原生智能体。

  • MCP is not dead; it’s being normalized into production plumbing: Despite a wave of “MCP is dead” jokes (example), the more technical takes cut the other way. @omarsar0 argued MCP’s issue is mostly a harness problem, not a protocol problem, and later noted that Anthropic’s new chart feature appears to be MCP-backed (tweet). Most concretely, @GergelyOrosz pointed to Uber using MCP internally as evidence that MCP is “the life blood” of agent-service integration inside larger companies. In practice, the market signal is clear: agent platforms now treat MCP as baseline interoperability rather than novelty.

MCP（Model Context Protocol，模型上下文协议）并未消亡；它正在常态化成为生产基础设施：尽管有一波"MCP 已死"的玩笑（示例），但更具技术性的观点却指向相反方向。@omarsar0 认为 MCP 的问题主要是 harness（框架/ harness）问题，而非协议问题，随后还指出 Anthropic 的新图表功能似乎就是基于 MCP 的（推文）。最具体的是，@GergelyOrosz 指出 Uber 在内部使用 MCP，以此证明 MCP 是大公司内部智能体-服务集成的"生命线"。实际上，市场信号很明确：智能体平台现在将 MCP 视为基础互操作性标准，而非新奇事物。

Coding Agents, Evaluation, and Dev Workflow Shifts

  • The coding-agent stack is maturing from demos into measurable systems: Cursor’s new CursorBench methodology is one of the stronger eval announcements in the set, combining offline benchmarks with online request-derived metrics to score models on both intelligence and efficiency; the team argues public coding benchmarks are increasingly saturated. OpenAI quickly highlighted that GPT-5.4 leads CursorBench on correctness with efficient token usage. Separately, Code Arena reported GPT-5.4-high in the top 6 for real-world web development tasks, while WeirdML results from @htihle showed strong but inconsistent performance and unusually long generated solutions. The common pattern: coding-model comparison is shifting toward multi-axis measurement—correctness, token efficiency, interaction behavior, and real task fit.

编程智能体技术栈正从演示走向可测量系统：Cursor 的新 CursorBench 方法论是其中较强的评估发布之一，结合了离线基准测试与在线请求派生指标，以在智能和效率两方面为模型打分；团队认为公开编程基准测试正日益饱和。OpenAI 迅速强调 GPT-5.4 在 CursorBench 上以高效的 token 使用率在正确性方面领先。另外，Code Arena 报告称 GPT-5.4-high 在现实世界 Web 开发任务中排名前 6，而 @htihle 的 WeirdML 结果显示性能强劲但不一致，且生成的解决方案异常冗长。共同模式是：编程模型比较正转向多轴测量——正确性、token 效率、交互行为和真实任务适配度。

  • Agent-assisted development is bifurcating into automation-heavy flows and “stay-in-the-loop” tooling: Several practitioners pushed back on the rush to fully autonomous coding. @ThePrimeagen argued that fast inline autocomplete still often outperforms agentic workflows in preserving understanding and reducing cognitive debt. In contrast, posts from @sydneyrunkle and @corbtt showed where agents excel today: reproducing bugs from screenshots, cross-tool organizational retrieval, and automating tedious coordination. OpenAI also shipped more operational features around this mode: Codex Automations are now GA with worktree vs. branch choice, model/reasoning controls, and reusable templates, plus UI customization in the app (themes update).

智能体辅助开发正分化为重度自动化流程和"保持循环内"工具两类：一些从业者反对急于实现完全自主编程。@ThePrimeagen 认为，快速行内自动补全在保持理解力和减少认知债务方面仍常优于智能体工作流。相比之下，@sydneyrunkle 和 @corbtt 的帖子展示了智能体目前的优势领域：从截图复现 bug、跨工具组织检索，以及自动化繁琐的协调工作。OpenAI 也围绕这种模式推出了更多操作功能：Codex Automations 现已全面可用（GA），支持 worktree 与 branch（工作树与分支）选择、模型/推理控制以及可重用模板，还有应用内的 UI 自定义（主题更新）。

  • Hermes Agent is emerging as a serious open agent platform: Nous’s Hermes Agent v0.2.0 shipped an unusually dense release for a two-week sprint, including full MCP client support, an ACP (Agent Communication Protocol) server for editors, provider expansion (including GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, OpenAI OAuth), filesystem checkpoints with rollback, git worktree isolation, local browser support, and subagent transparency as summarized by @witcheer. Follow-up updates added official Claude provider support and lighter installs. Community reaction suggests real adoption, including migration away from OpenClaw (example).

Hermes Agent 正成为一个严肃的开源智能体平台：Nous 的 Hermes Agent v0.2.0 在两周的冲刺中发布了异常密集的版本，包括完整的 MCP 客户端支持、用于编辑器的 ACP（智能体通信协议）服务器、提供商扩展（包括 GLM、Kimi、MiniMax、OpenAI OAuth）、支持回滚的文件系统检查点、git worktree（Git 工作树）隔离、本地浏览器支持，以及 @witcheer 总结的子智能体透明化。后续更新添加了官方 Claude 提供商支持和更轻量的安装。社区反响表明其获得了真正的采用，包括从 OpenClaw 迁移过来的用户（示例）。

Multimodal Retrieval, Embeddings, and New Interaction Surfaces

  • A big week for multimodal retrieval: Google’s Gemini Embedding 2 is its first natively multimodal embedding model, mapping text, images, audio, video, and PDFs into one vector space. Posts from Weaviate and @victorialslocum highlighted practical use cases like multimodal PDF RAG, flexible output dimensions via Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL, 俄罗斯套娃表示学习), and native support in retrieval pipelines. The strongest competitive response came from Mixedbread’s Wholembed v3, which claims SOTA (State-of-the-Art, 最先进) retrieval across modalities and 100+ languages, with the team and outside observers stressing late-interaction / multi-vector design as the differentiator (@bclavie, @lateinteraction).

多模态检索的重要一周：Google 的 Gemini Embedding 2 是其首个原生多模态嵌入模型，将文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF 映射到统一的向量空间。Weaviate 和 @victorialslocum 的帖子强调了诸如多模态 PDF RAG（检索增强生成）、通过 Matryoshka Representation Learning（MRL，俄罗斯套娃表示学习）实现灵活输出维度，以及在检索管道中的原生支持等实际用例。最强的竞争回应来自 Mixedbread 的 Wholembed v3，该模型声称在跨模态和 100 多种语言上实现了 SOTA（最先进）检索，团队与外部观察者都强调延迟交互/多向量（late-interaction / multi-vector）设计是其差异化优势（@bclavie、@lateinteraction）。

  • The retrieval debate is crystallizing around single-vector vs. multi-vector: The most technically opinionated commentary came from @lateinteraction, arguing that new multimodal single-vector baselines like Gemini Embedding 2 were almost immediately outperformed by scaled ColBERT/ColPali-style approaches, and later stating it is “borderline irrational” to keep betting on single-vector embeddings (tweet). Even allowing for hype, the broader takeaway is important: retrieval teams are increasingly prioritizing interaction-rich indexing/scoring over one-vector simplicity, provided infra can make it practical at scale (TopK infrastructure note).

检索领域的争论正围绕单向量与多向量逐渐明朗：最具技术性的观点来自 @lateinteraction，他认为像 Gemini Embedding 2 这样的新多模态单向量基线几乎立即被规模化的 ColBERT/ColPali 风格方法超越，随后还表示继续押注单向量嵌入"近乎非理性"（推文）。即使考虑到炒作成分，更广泛的启示依然重要：检索团队正越来越优先考虑富交互索引/评分（interaction-rich indexing/scoring），而非单向量的简洁性，前提是基础设施能使其在大规模下实用（TopK 基础设施说明）。

  • Interfaces are getting richer, not just smarter: Anthropic’s Claude can now generate interactive charts and diagrams directly in chat, a notable product step toward generative UI rather than plain text outputs. This resonated with builders already assembling similar systems via MCP (@omarsar0). In parallel, Perplexity Computer rolled out to Pro users with 20+ models, skills, and connectors, and @alexalbert__ summarized the broader product trend as “Generative UI is here.”

界面正变得更丰富，而不仅仅是更智能：Anthropic 的 Claude 现在可以直接在聊天中生成交互式图表和图示，这是向生成式 UI（generative UI）而非纯文本输出迈出的重要产品一步。这与那些已通过 MCP 构建类似系统的开发者产生共鸣（@omarsar0）。与此同时，Perplexity Computer 向 Pro 用户推出，支持 20 多种模型、技能和连接器，@alexalbert__ 将更广泛的产品趋势总结为"生成式 UI 已经到来"。

Model Releases, Benchmarks, and Efficiency Trends

  • NVIDIA’s Nemotron 3 Super stands out as the most technically discussed model release: The release was highlighted by @rasbt as an open-weight 120B model with strong throughput and benchmarks roughly in the Qwen3.5/GPT-OSS class. The architecture drew extra attention because of its LatentMoE design; @cwolferesearch provided a useful breakdown showing how routing in a lower-dimensional latent space reduces both all-to-all communication costs and expert weight loading costs, then reinvests those savings into more experts and more active experts per token. It is one of the clearer examples in the set of architecture changes aimed at better inference economics, not just benchmark chasing.

NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 3 Super 是技术讨论最多的模型发布：@rasbt 强调这是一个开放权重 120B 模型，具有强吞吐量和大致处于 Qwen3.5/GPT-OSS 级别的基准测试成绩。其架构因 LatentMoE（潜在混合专家）设计而备受关注；@cwolferesearch 提供了有用的拆解，展示如何在低维潜在空间中进行路由，从而减少全对全通信成本和专家权重加载成本，然后将这些节省的资源重新投入到更多专家和每 token 更多活跃专家上。这是该系列中更清晰的架构变更示例之一，旨在实现更好的推理经济性，而不仅仅是追求基准测试成绩。

  • Grok 4.20 Beta looks more like a cost/speed/behavior update than a frontier leap: Artificial Analysis’s evaluation puts Grok 4.20 (reasoning) at 48 on its Intelligence Index, below current top models but with a larger 2M context window, lower pricing ($2/$6 per 1M in/out tokens), strong speed, and the best measured score so far on its non-hallucination metric. Follow-up commentary from @scaling01 and Vals broadly reinforced that story: not frontier-topping, but cheaper, faster, and potentially more usable in some production settings.

Grok 4.20 Beta 看起来更像是成本/速度/行为更新，而非前沿能力的飞跃：Artificial Analysis 的评估将 Grok 4.20 (reasoning) 在其智能指数中列为 48 分，低于当前顶级模型，但拥有更大的 200 万 token 上下文窗口、更低的价格（每百万输入/输出 token 2/6 美元）、强劲的速度，以及迄今为止在其非幻觉指标上的最佳测量分数。@scaling01 和 Vals 的后续评论普遍强化了这一说法：不是最顶尖的前沿模型，但更便宜、更快，在某些生产环境中可能更实用。

  • Efficiency and architecture remain central themes: The day also included FLUX.2 klein 9B-KV, which is reported as 2x–2.5x faster for image editing with no quality drop, and Reka Edge, a 7B VLM (Vision-Language Model, 视觉语言模型) pitched around 98ms time-to-first-token and low-latency agentic/on-device use. On the research side, tweets surfaced work on looped transformers with gated memory banks, LM head gradient bottlenecks, reasoning probes for early CoT exit, and Flash-KMeans, all consistent with a field still searching for gains in training signal quality, inference efficiency, and adaptive compute.

效率和架构仍是核心主题：当天还包括 FLUX.2 klein 9B-KV，据报道其图像编辑速度提升 2-2.5 倍且质量无下降，以及 Reka Edge，一个 70 亿参数 VLM（视觉语言模型），主打 98 毫秒首 token 时间（time-to-first-token）和低延迟智能体/端侧使用。在研究方面，推文披露了关于带门控记忆库的循环 Transformer、语言模型头梯度瓶颈、用于早期 CoT（思维链）退出的推理探针，以及 Flash-KMeans 等工作，这些都与该领域仍在寻求训练信号质量、推理效率和自适应计算（adaptive compute）提升的趋势一致。

Applied AI: Maps, Health, Video, and Forecasting

  • Google Maps is being rebuilt around Gemini as an interaction layer, not just a map layer: Google’s Maps upgrade thread describes the biggest product update in over a decade, with two notable pieces: a conversational “Ask Maps” mode over Google’s places/community graph, and Immersive Navigation with richer 3D route guidance (details). The more interesting engineering implication came from observers like @dbreunig: the future UX may not “look like a map” at all, with LLMs acting as the primary interface to geospatial knowledge.

Google Maps（谷歌地图）正围绕 Gemini 重建为交互层，而不仅仅是地图层：Google 的地图升级线程描述了十多年来的最大产品更新，有两个显著特点：基于 Google 地点/社区图谱的对话式 "Ask Maps"（询问地图）模式，以及具备更丰富 3D 路线指引的沉浸式导航（Immersive Navigation）（详情）。更有趣的工程启示来自 @dbreunig 等观察者：未来的用户体验可能根本"不像地图"，LLM 将成为地理空间知识的主要交互界面。

  • Healthcare copilots are moving toward longitudinal personal context: Microsoft introduced Copilot Health, a US launch that can aggregate EHR (Electronic Health Records, 电子健康档案) records, wearables, personal history, and lab data into a dedicated health profile. The company stressed that user data is not used to train models, and that outputs are grounded in trusted health sources with citations. Separately, Glass Health added self-serve EHR integrations for athenaOne and eClinicalWorks, showing similar movement toward AI systems that are useful only once they are deeply connected to real clinical data systems.

医疗 copilot（AI 助手）正朝着纵向个人上下文发展：Microsoft 推出了 Copilot Health，在美国上线，可以整合 EHR（电子健康档案）记录、可穿戴设备、个人病史和实验室数据到专属健康档案中。公司强调用户数据不会用于训练模型，且输出基于可信健康来源并附带引用。另一方面，Glass Health 为 athenaOne 和 eClinicalWorks 添加了自助式 EHR 集成，显示出类似的趋势——只有当 AI 系统与真实临床数据系统深度连接时才有用。

  • Video generation APIs are getting more product-ready: OpenAI’s Sora 2-powered Video API update added custom characters/objects, 16:9 and 9:16 export, 20-second clips, continuation, and batch jobs, which is a pragmatic set of features for campaign, storyboarding, and UGC workflows rather than pure research demos.

视频生成 API 正变得更具产品就绪性：OpenAI 由 Sora 2 驱动的视频 API 更新添加了自定义角色/物体、16:9 和 9:16 导出、20 秒片段、续写和批量作业等功能，这是一组面向营销活动、故事板和 UGC（用户生成内容）工作流的实用功能，而非纯粹的研究演示。

  • Groundsource is one of the stronger “AI for public-good data” announcements: Google Research’s Groundsource uses Gemini to turn 5M+ public reports into a dataset of 2.6M+ flood events across 150+ countries, enabling urban flash-flood forecasting up to 24 hours in advance. The methodological point is broader than floods: using multimodal/LLM pipelines to synthesize structured, open benchmarks from noisy public corpora could become an important pattern for under-instrumented domains.

Groundsource 是最有力的"AI 用于公益数据"发布之一：Google Research（谷歌研究院）的 Groundsource 使用 Gemini 将500 多万份公开报告转化为涵盖150 多个国家的260 多万起洪水事件数据集，能够实现提前24 小时的城市山洪预警。其方法论意义比洪水本身更广泛：使用多模态/LLM 管道从嘈杂的公共语料库合成结构化、开放的基准数据，可能成为仪器不足领域的重要模式。

Top tweets (by engagement)

  • Claude interactive charts and diagrams: Anthropic launched interactive charts/diagrams in chat, one of the clearest examples this week of LLMs moving toward richer frontends rather than better text alone.

Claude 交互式图表和图示：Anthropic 推出了聊天中的交互式图表/图示，这是本周 LLM 向更丰富前端而非单纯更好文本发展的最清晰示例之一。

  • Google Maps + Gemini: Google’s major Maps upgrade was by far the biggest mainstream product launch in the set, with conversational place search and immersive navigation.

Google Maps + Gemini：Google 的地图重大升级是这一系列中最大的主流产品发布，具备对话式地点搜索和沉浸式导航。

  • CursorBench / coding evals: Cursor’s new eval methodology for coding agents drew outsized attention because it addresses a real gap: how to evaluate coding systems on both capability and efficiency using a mix of online and offline signals.

CursorBench / 编程评估：Cursor 的编程智能体新评估方法论吸引了超额关注，因为它解决了一个真正的空白：如何使用在线和离线信号的混合来评估编程系统的能力和效率。

  • Perplexity Computer rollout: Perplexity Computer for Pro users signals continued appetite for “computer-use” products with broader connectors/skills rather than one-model chat.

Perplexity Computer 推出：面向 Pro 用户的 Perplexity Computer 表明市场对"计算机使用"产品的持续需求，这类产品具有更广泛的连接器/技能，而非单一模型对话。

  • OpenJarvis on-device personal AI: Stanford’s OpenJarvis launch stood out as a serious local-first framework for personal AI on device, with modular infra, local retrieval, MCP tools, and efficiency-aware evaluation.

OpenJarvis 端侧个人 AI：Stanford（斯坦福）的 OpenJarvis 发布作为一个严肃的本地优先框架脱颖而出，用于设备上的个人 AI，具备模块化基础设施、本地检索、MCP 工具和效率感知评估。

AI Reddit Recap

/r/LocalLlama + /r/localLLM Recap

1. Qwen3.5 Model Performance and Benchmarks

  • Qwen3.5-9B is actually quite good for agentic coding (Activity: 428): The post discusses the performance of Qwen 3.5-9B on an Nvidia Geforce RTX 3060 with 12 GB VRAM, highlighting its effectiveness for agentic coding tasks. The user compared various models, including Qwen 2.5 Coder and Unsloth quantizations on Qwen 3 Coder, noting that 1-bit quantizations were fast but unreliable for tool calls, while 2-bit quantizations were slower and unstable. The Qwen3.5-9B model, however, performed well, maintaining functionality for over an hour without issues, suggesting it is well-suited for consumer hardware with limited VRAM. The user also mentions Unsloth-Qwen3 Coder 30B UD-TQ1_0 as effective for code completion. One commenter noted that Qwen3.5-9B performs comparably to larger models like GPT-120B, while another shared a negative experience where the model disrupted their build system, indicating variability in performance. A link to another model, OmniCoder-9B-GGUF, was also shared as a potential alternative.

Qwen3.5-9B 在智能体编程方面表现相当出色（活跃度：428）：该帖子讨论了 Qwen 3.5-9B 在配备 12 GB VRAM（显存）的 Nvidia Geforce RTX 3060 上的性能，强调了其在智能体编程（agentic coding）任务中的有效性。用户比较了多种模型，包括 Qwen 2.5 Coder 和 Qwen 3 Coder 的 Unsloth 量化版本，指出 1-bit 量化速度快但工具调用不可靠，而 2-bit 量化较慢且不稳定。然而，Qwen3.5-9B 模型表现良好，保持功能一个多小时无问题，表明它非常适合显存有限的消费级硬件。用户还提到 Unsloth-Qwen3 Coder 30B UD-TQ1_0 在代码补全方面很有效。一位评论者指出 Qwen3.5-9B 的性能可与 GPT-120B 等更大模型相媲美，而另一位分享了负面体验，称该模型破坏了其构建系统，表明性能存在差异。还分享了另一个模型 OmniCoder-9B-GGUF 的链接作为潜在替代方案。

  • The Qwen3.5-9B model is noted for its impressive performance, benchmarking around the level of GPT-3’s 120B model, which is surprising given its smaller size. This suggests that Qwen3.5-9B is highly efficient in terms of performance relative to its size, making it a strong contender in the field of agentic coding.

Qwen3.5-9B 模型因其令人印象深刻的性能而备受关注，基准测试水平接近 GPT-3 的 120B 模型，考虑到其更小的尺寸，这令人惊讶。这表明 Qwen3.5-9B 在相对于其尺寸的性能方面非常高效，使其成为智能体编程领域的强有力竞争者。

  • Despite its strengths, Qwen3.5-9B has been reported to cause significant issues in some cases, such as completely disrupting a build system and deleting projects. This indicates that while the model can perform well, it may also have stability issues or bugs that need addressing, especially when used in complex environments like LM Studio and Claude Code on an RTX 4060.

尽管有其优势，但据报道 Qwen3.5-9B 在某些情况下会导致严重问题，例如完全破坏构建系统和删除项目。这表明虽然该模型可以表现良好，但也可能存在稳定性问题或需要修复的 bug，特别是在 RTX 4060 上使用 LM Studio 和 Claude Code 等复杂环境时。

  • There is a debate around the utility of lower quantized models like Qwen3.5-9B, with some users arguing that these models can indeed perform useful tasks despite their smaller size. This challenges the notion that only larger models are capable of high-quality outputs, highlighting the potential of optimized smaller models in practical applications.

关于像 Qwen3.5-9B 这样的低量化模型的实用性存在争论，一些用户认为这些模型尽管尺寸较小，但确实可以执行有用的任务。这挑战了只有更大模型才能产生高质量输出的观念，凸显了优化后的小模型在实际应用中的潜力。

  • I spent 8+ hours benchmarking every MoE backend for Qwen3.5-397B NVFP4 on 4x RTX PRO 6000 (SM120). Here’s what I found. (Activity: 349): The post details an extensive benchmarking effort on the nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4 model using 4x RTX PRO 6000 GPUs, achieving a maximum of 50.5 tok/s despite claims of 130+ tok/s. The bottleneck is attributed to NVIDIA’s CUTLASS kernels, which fail on SM120 hardware due to a bug in the initialization of TMA Warp Specialized grouped GEMM tactics, as documented in CUTLASS issue #3096. The author suggests that the issue is due to a Shared Memory (SMEM) overflow caused by datacenter assumptions, with SM120 having a strict limit of 101 KiB compared to datacenter variants. The post also highlights that Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) results in a -22% performance regression due to dequantization discrepancies. The author has submitted patches to FlashInfer and vLLM to address some of these issues, but the core problem remains unresolved by NVIDIA.

我花了 8 个多小时在 4x RTX PRO 6000 (SM120) 上为 Qwen3.5-397B NVFP4 基准测试每个 MoE 后端。以下是我的发现。（活跃度：349）：该帖子详细描述了对 nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4 模型使用 4 块 RTX PRO 6000 GPU 进行的广泛基准测试，最高达到 50.5 tok/s，尽管声称可达 130+ tok/s。瓶颈归因于 NVIDIA 的 CUTLASS 内核，由于 TMA Warp 专用分组 GEMM 策略初始化中的错误，在 SM120 硬件上失败，记录在 CUTLASS issue #3096 中。作者认为问题是由于数据中心假设导致的共享内存 (SMEM) 溢出，SM120 有严格的 101 KiB 限制，而数据中心版本更高。帖子还强调，由于反量化差异，多 token 预测 (MTP) 导致 -22% 的性能回归。作者已向 FlashInfer 和 vLLM 提交补丁以解决部分问题，但核心问题仍待 NVIDIA 解决。

  • A commenter suggests that the author’s bug report on GitHub is too verbose and lacks clear reproduction steps, which may be why NVIDIA hasn’t addressed it. Another commenter identifies the root cause of the SM120 issue as a physical SMEM overflow and suggests that smaller tile shapes could resolve the problem. A third commenter notes that running the setup on bare metal Linux could improve performance by ~10% compared to WSL2.

一位评论者建议作者在 GitHub 上的错误报告过于冗长且缺乏清晰的复现步骤，这可能是 NVIDIA 尚未解决该问题的原因。另一位评论者将 SM120 问题的根本原因确定为物理 SMEM 溢出，并建议更小的 tile shape（瓦片形状）可以解决问题。第三位评论者指出，在裸机 Linux 上运行设置比 WSL2 可提高约 10% 的性能。

  • lawdawgattorney provides a detailed analysis of a bug affecting the Qwen3.5-397B NVFP4 model on RTX PRO 6000 GPUs. The issue is traced to a Shared Memory (SMEM) overflow due to datacenter assumptions, where the SM120 dies have a strict 101 KiB limit compared to datacenter dies with ~227 KiB. The auto-computation formula for pipeline stages fails to account for alignas(1024) padding, causing a kErrorInternal crash. A temporary fix involves hardcoding StageCount<2>, but this reduces performance to 4.8 tok/s due to memory latency issues. The proposed solution is to support smaller tile shapes to fit more pipeline stages within the SM120’s SMEM constraints.

lawdawgattorney 提供了影响 RTX PRO 6000 GPU 上 Qwen3.5-397B NVFP4 模型的错误的详细分析。问题追溯到由于数据中心假设导致的共享内存 (SMEM) 溢出，SM120 芯片有严格的 101 KiB 限制，而数据中心芯片约为 227 KiB。管道阶段的自动计算公式未能考虑 alignas(1024) 填充，导致 kErrorInternal 崩溃。临时修复涉及硬编码 StageCount<2>，但由于内存延迟问题，这会将性能降低到 4.8 tok/s。提出的解决方案是支持更小的 tile shape（瓦片形状），以在 SM120 的 SMEM 限制内容纳更多管道阶段。

  • JockY criticizes the original bug report for being overly verbose and lacking essential details such as reproduction instructions and error logs. The report’s excessive length and inclusion of irrelevant benchmarks make it difficult for developers to address the issue. JockY suggests a more concise approach, focusing on clear reproduction steps and error logs to facilitate debugging and resolution by developers.

JockY 批评原始错误报告过于冗长且缺乏基本细节，如复现说明和错误日志。报告过长且包含不相关的基准测试，使开发者难以解决问题。JockY 建议采用更简洁的方法，专注于清晰的复现步骤和错误日志，以便开发者调试和解决。

  • AndreVallestero suggests running the benchmarks on bare metal Linux instead of WSL2, noting a potential performance improvement of approximately 10%. This implies that the virtualization layer in WSL2 might introduce overhead that affects the performance of GPU-intensive tasks like those involved in running the Qwen3.5-397B NVFP4 model.

AndreVallestero 建议在裸机 Linux 而非 WSL2 上运行基准测试，指出潜在的性能提升约为 10%。这意味着 WSL2 中的虚拟化层可能引入开销，影响运行 Qwen3.5-397B NVFP4 模型等 GPU 密集型任务的性能。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Shopify Liquid 性能优化：解析渲染提速53%，内存分配减少61%
item.description:
标签: #性能优化 #AI编程 #代码优化

摘要: Shopify CEO Tobi运用AI编码代理对Liquid模板引擎进行自动化微优化，实现了53%的解析渲染提速和61%的内存分配减少，展示了完善的测试套件结合AI"自动研究"模式能显著释放遗留代码的性能潜力。

原标题: Shopify/liquid: Performance: 53% faster parse+render, 61% fewer allocations

Shopify/liquid: Performance: 53% faster parse+render, 61% fewer allocations

Tobi found dozens of new performance micro-optimizations using a variant of autoresearch, Andrej Karpathy's new system for having a coding agent run hundreds of semi-autonomous experiments to find new effective techniques for training nanochat.

Tobi 利用 autoresearch（自动研究）的一种变体，发现了数十个新的性能微优化方案。Andrej Karpathy 的新系统通过让编码智能体运行数百个半自主实验，来寻找训练 nanochat 的新有效技术。

Tobi's implementation started two days ago with this autoresearch.md prompt file and an autoresearch.sh script for the agent to run to execute the test suite and report on benchmark scores.

Tobi 的实现始于两天前，使用了 autoresearch.md 提示词文件和 autoresearch.sh 脚本，供智能体运行以执行测试套件（test suite）并报告基准测试分数。

The PR now lists 93 commits from around 120 automated experiments. The PR description lists what worked in detail - some examples:

该 PR（Pull Request，拉取请求）现在列出了来自约 120 次自动化实验的 93 个 commits（提交）。PR 描述详细列出了有效的优化方案——例如：

Replaced StringScanner tokenizer with String#byteindex. Single-byte byteindex searching is ~40% faster than regex-based skip_until. This alone reduced parse time by ~12%. Pure-byte parse_tag_token. Eliminated the costly StringScanner#string= reset that was called for every {% %} token (878 times). Manual byte scanning for tag name + markup extraction is faster than resetting and re-scanning via StringScanner. [...] Cached small integer to_s. Pre-computed frozen strings for 0-999 avoid 267 Integer#to_s allocations per render.

将 StringScanner 分词器替换为 String#byteindex。单字节 byteindex 搜索比基于正则表达式的 skip_until 快约 40%。仅此一项就将解析时间减少了约 12%。纯字节 parse_tag_token。消除了每个 {% %} 标记（878 次）调用的昂贵的 StringScanner#string= 重置操作。通过手动字节扫描提取标记名和标记内容，比通过 StringScanner 重置和重新扫描更快。[...] 缓存小整数的 to_s。对 0-999 预先计算的冻结字符串（frozen strings）避免了每次渲染 267 次 Integer#to_s 的内存分配。

  • Replaced StringScanner tokenizer with String#byteindex. Single-byte byteindex searching is ~40% faster than regex-based skip_until. This alone reduced parse time by ~12%.
  • Pure-byte parse_tag_token. Eliminated the costly StringScanner#string= reset that was called for every {% %} token (878 times). Manual byte scanning for tag name + markup extraction is faster than resetting and re-scanning via StringScanner. [...]
  • Cached small integer to_s. Pre-computed frozen strings for 0-999 avoid 267 Integer#to_s allocations per render.

  • 使用 String#byteindex 替代 StringScanner 分词器。单字节 byteindex 搜索比基于正则表达式的 skip_until 快约 40%。仅此一项就将解析时间减少了约 12%。
  • 纯字节 parse_tag_token。消除了每个 {% %} 标记（878 次）调用的昂贵的 StringScanner#string= 重置操作。通过手动字节扫描提取标记名和标记内容，比通过 StringScanner 重置和重新扫描更快。[...]
  • 缓存小整数的 to_s。对 0-999 预先计算的冻结字符串避免了每次渲染 267 次 Integer#to_s 的内存分配。

This all added up to a 53% improvement on benchmarks - truly impressive for a codebase that's been tweaked by hundreds of contributors over 20 years.

所有这些优化叠加在一起，在基准测试（benchmarks）中实现了 53% 的性能提升——对于一个 20 年来经数百名贡献者不断调优的代码库来说，这着实令人印象深刻。

I think this illustrates a number of interesting ideas:

我认为这阐明了几个有趣的观点：

  • Having a robust test suite - in this case 974 unit tests - is a massive unlock for working with coding agents. This kind of research effort would not be possible without first having a tried and tested suite of tests.
  • The autoresearch pattern - where an agent brainstorms a multitude of potential improvements and then experiments with them one at a time - is really effective.
  • If you provide an agent with a benchmarking script "make it faster" becomes an actionable goal.
  • CEOs can code again! Tobi has always been more hands-on than most, but this is a much more significant contribution than anyone would expect from the leader of a company with 7,500+ employees. I've seen this pattern play out a lot over the past few months: coding agents make it feasible for people in high-interruption roles to productively work with code again.

  • 拥有健壮的测试套件（test suite）——本例中有 974 个单元测试（unit tests）——是与编码智能体（coding agents）协作的巨大优势（massive unlock）。如果没有先建立一套经过验证的测试套件，这种研究努力是不可能实现的。
  • autoresearch pattern（自动研究模式）——即智能体集思广益提出大量潜在改进方案，然后逐一进行实验——确实非常有效。
  • 如果你为智能体提供一个基准测试脚本，"让它更快"就会变成一个可执行的目标。
  • CEO 们又能写代码了！Tobi 一直比大多数人更亲力亲为，但这对于一个拥有 7500 多名员工的公司的领导者来说，是一个比任何人预期都要重大的贡献。在过去的几个月里，我经常看到这种情况：编码智能体（coding agents）使那些经常被打断工作的人能够再次高效地编写代码。

Here's Tobi's GitHub contribution graph for the past year, showing a significant uptick following that November 2025 inflection point when coding agents got really good.

这是 Tobi 过去一年在 GitHub 上的贡献图，显示了自 2025 年 11 月拐点（November 2025 inflection point）以来——即编码智能体变得真正出色之时——贡献量显著上升。

He used Pi as the coding agent and released a new pi-autoresearch plugin in collaboration with David Cortés, which maintains state in an autoresearch.jsonl file like this one.

他使用 Pi 作为编码智能体，并与 David Cortés 合作发布了一个新的 pi-autoresearch 插件，该插件在 autoresearch.jsonl 文件中维护状态，就像这样。

item.description:
标签: #自建软件 #AI编程 #会计工具

摘要: 作者因市面现有会计软件无法满足其复杂的跨境财务需求，仅用五天时间借助AI（Claude）打造了一款完全本地化、高度定制化的个人会计工具，实现了从多货币处理、智能文档分类到AI辅助异常检测的全流程自动化，完美契合其个性化财务管理需求。

原标题: Quoting Craig Mod

Quoting Craig Mod

Simply put: It's a big mess, and no off-the-shelf accounting software does what I need. So after years of pain, I finally sat down last week and started to build my own. It took me about five days. I am now using the best piece of accounting software I've ever used. It's blazing fast. Entirely local. Handles multiple currencies and pulls daily (historical) conversion rates. It's able to ingest any CSV I throw at it and represent it in my dashboard as needed. It knows US and Japan tax requirements, and formats my expenses and medical bills appropriately for my accountants. I feed it past returns to learn from. I dump 1099s and K1s and PDFs from hospitals into it, and it categorizes and organizes and packages them all as needed. It reconciles international wire transfers, taking into account small variations in FX rates and time for the transfers to complete. It learns as I categorize expenses and categorizes automatically going forward. It's easy to do spot checks on data. If I find an anomaly, I can talk directly to Claude and have us brainstorm a batched solution, often saving me from having to manually modify hundreds of entries. And often resulting in a new, small, feature tweak. The software feels organic and pliable in a form perfectly shaped to my hand, able to conform to any hunk of data I throw at it. It feels like bushwhacking with a lightsaber.

—Craig Mod, Software Bonkers

简而言之：这简直是一团糟，没有一款 off-the-shelf accounting software（现成会计软件） 能满足我的需求。因此，在多年的痛苦之后，我上周终于坐下来开始构建自己的系统。大约花了五天时间。我现在正在使用我用过的最好的会计软件。它快如闪电，完全本地运行，支持多币种并拉取每日（历史）汇率。它能导入我扔给它的任何 CSV（逗号分隔值） 文件，并按需在仪表盘中展示。它了解美国和日本的税务要求，并能按照我的会计师的要求格式化我的开支和医疗账单。我喂给它过去的报税表让它学习。我把 1099s（独立承包商税务表）和 K1s（合伙企业收益表）以及医院的 PDF 文件丢进去，它能按需分类、整理和打包。它能对账国际电汇，考虑到 FX rates（外汇汇率） 的微小差异以及转账完成所需的时间。它在我分类开支时学习，并自动对未来的开支进行分类。对数据进行抽查很容易。如果我发现异常，我可以直接与 Claude（AI 助手）对话，让我们头脑风暴出一个批量解决方案，通常能帮我避免手动修改数百条条目。而且往往会带来一个新的小功能调整。这款软件感觉有机且可塑，形态完美地契合我的手，能够适应我扔给它的任何数据块。感觉就像用光剑披荆斩棘。
